title: Solutions Architect, AI and ML
description_html: NVIDIA is building the world’s leading AI company, and we are looking for an experienced Cloud Solution Architect to help assist customers with adoption of GPU hardware and Software, as well as building and deploying Machine Learning (ML) , Deep Learning (DL), data analytics solutions on various Cloud Computing Platforms. As part of the Solutions Architecture team, we work with some of the most exciting computing hardware and software technologies including the latest breakthroughs in machine learning and data science. A Solutions Architect is the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA and our customers so you will engage directly with developers, researchers, and data scientists with some of NVIDIA’s most strategic technology customers as well as work directly with business and engineering teams on product strategy. We are looking for a Solutions Architect to help drive end-to-end technology solutions applying NVIDIA’s full set of technologies based on business needs of customers. Join us in this exciting endeavor!    What you will be doing:    Working with Cloud Service Providers to develop and demonstrate solutions based on NVIDIA’s ML/DL and data science software and hardware technologies  Build and deploy AI/ML solutions at scale using NVIDIA's AI software on cloud-based GPU platforms.  Build custom PoCs for solution that address customer’s critical business needs applying NVIDIA hardware and software technology  Partner with Sales Account Managers or Developer Relations Managers to identify and secure new business opportunities for NVIDIA products and solutions for ML/DL and other software solutions  Prepare and deliver technical content to customers including presentations about purpose-built solutions, workshops about NVIDIA products and solutions, etc.  Conduct regular technical customer meetings for project/product roadmap, feature discussions, and intro to new technologies. Establish close technical ties to the customer to facilitate rapid resolution of customer issues     What we need to see:    4+ years of Solutions Engineering (or similar Sales Engineering roles)  3+ years of work-related experience in Deep Learning and Machine Learning, including deep learning frameworks TensorFlow or PyTorch, GPU, and CUDA experience extremely helpful.  BS/MS/PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.  Established track record of deploying solutions in cloud computing environments including AWS, GCP, or Azure  Knowledge of DevOps/ML Ops technologies such as Docker/containers, Kubernetes, data center deployments  Ability to use at least one scripting language (i.e., Python)  Good programming and debugging skills  Ability to communicate your ideas/code clearly through documents, presentation etc.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    AWS, GCP or Azure Professional Solution Architect Certification.  Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPUs and SDKs (e.g. CUDA, RAPIDS, Triton etc.)  System-level experience specifically GPU-based systems  Experience with Deep Learning at scale  Familiarity with parallel programming and distributed computing platforms    We make extensive use of conferencing tools, but occasional travel is required for local on-site visit to customers and industry events. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 27, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Lead Technical Program Manager Fraud Technology
description_html: The  Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology  is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.      Key Responsibilities    End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution    Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.  Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.  Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.  Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.    Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration    Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.  Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.  Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.    AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence    Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:  Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).  Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.  Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.      Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication    Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.  Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.  Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).  Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.    Risk, Governance, and Control Management    Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.  Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).  Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.          Qualifications & Competencies       Experience & Domain Expertise     10+ years of experience  in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.   2+ years of experience  supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.  Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.  Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.  Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.    Project Management & AI Tooling    PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.  Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.  Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.    Leadership & Communication    Demonstrated ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, drive consensus, and influence technical and business partners in a cross-functional environment.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business-focused messaging.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.    Education    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.       Other Relevant Skills  Delivery Management, Project Management, Stakeholder Management                 ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family Group:   Technology             ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family:  Business Analysis / Client Services         ------------------------------------------------------           Time Type:  Full time   ------------------------------------------------------     Most Relevant Skills   Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------   Other Relevant Skills   For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------    Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.             If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review     Accessibility at Citi  .
